messages:
meera-sales: FYI — meeting with Meridian Bank in 45m. They want an 6-week POC proving EU+APAC data residency and explicit no-US-control-plane. Need short-term reserved pricing and a BYOK flow.
jake-solutions: Noted. Main checklist: (1) ingress/egress confined to eu/ap, (2) control plane signalling local-only, (3) BYOK HSM in-county, (4) subprocessors list + attestation for those regions.
nina-eng: Quick tech reality: Hosted endpoints available in eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1. For strict "no-US-control-plane" we should propose Dedicated Private control plane (VPC peering) — hosted still ships billing telemetry to us-east today.
jake-solutions: Can we offer a short-term Dedicated pool? Procurement prefers month-to-month. We'll need a setup fee and a pro-rated reserved rate.
omar-legal: I'll prepare the subproc export for eu & ap and attach SOC2/attestation for cloud infra and logging. Also note we can temporally commit residency in an addendum for the POC.
kms-bot: BYOK checklist created: https://redwood.internal/kms/poc-1799977777 — includes HSM attestation template and keystore connector notes.
nina-eng: Technical caveat to present: `routing_policy: primary=eu-west-1, secondary=ap-northeast-1, fallback=disabled` — this meets residency but loses cross-region fallback and increases outage risk. We'll document SLO tradeoffs.
jake-solutions: I'll draft two options for the call slides: Option A = Dedicated private-control-plane (compliant) with 6-week reserved cost and setup. Option B = Hosted geo-pin (faster) but not compliant for strict residency.
meera-sales: Perfect. Action list for the call: @nina-eng confirm whether metric suppression can be fast-tracked; @omar-legal attach subproc attestation; @jake-solutions prepare short-term invoice numbers. If we can promise BYOK + private CP for the POC, they sign.
meera-sales: Attaching the ticket: ops link will be shared on the call.
